snippet.title: Zohran Mamdani enseña en ESPAÑOL cómo DEFENDERSE del ICE en la era TRUMP
snippet.description:
El alcalde de Nueva York, Zohran Mamdani, ha publicado un vídeo íntegramente en español para explicar a los inmigrantes cómo actuar ante una posible intervención del Servicio de Inmigración y Control de Aduanas (ICE).

Mamdani recuerda que los agentes necesitan una orden judicial para entrar legalmente en determinados espacios privados, explica el derecho a guardar silencio y recomienda consultar con un abogado antes de firmar documentos. También insiste en que los inmigrantes no están solos y defiende el derecho constitucional a protestar. 

En plena política migratoria de Donald Trump, el vídeo reabre el debate sobre la actuación de las autoridades federales y el papel de Nueva York en la protección de sus comunidades inmigrantes.

snippet.title: Bayern Munich STATEMENT on Kompany’s HEALTH after COLLAPSING at training | FULL UPDATE
snippet.description:
Bayern Munich coach Vincent Kompany remains in hospital after collapsing during a training session on Friday (October 23), and the club says he is stable. The Belgian had been battling a virus and had missed some training sessions in recent days. He was at the reserve team's session when he needed medical attention, the German champions said.

Kompany is undergoing a thorough examination and will remain under medical care, the club said, and his coaching staff will handle training and match duties in the meantime. Sporting director Max Eberl told a press conference on Saturday (October 24) that Kompany had spoken on Friday evening, including with his wife, and called the episode "not a pleasant moment" for everyone at the club.

Eberl said the club's priority is establishing the cause, letting Kompany recover in peace and allowing him to return only once he feels fit. "Protecting him will be the biggest task for all of us," Eberl said, adding that this includes protecting him from himself. He said no recovery timeline has been set and that the club would first establish what the illness is before deciding how to treat it. "We won't be talking about days; we'll be talking about weeks," he said.

Co-trainer Aaron Danks said the staff would keep football discussions with Kompany to a minimum so he could focus on his family and his health, and that the squad would share the workload. Danks said he was confident in the players' professionalism and team spirit, which he credited partly to Kompany. Bayern, the Bundesliga leaders, are due to travel to Freiburg on Sunday (October 25).
